svg.aria-label: Your phone, a waterplane web app or Android app, reaches your desktop over Tailscale, encrypted, with no waterplane server and no account. On the desktop the waterplane daemon types into the real claude CLI running in a PTY, which works in your repos; the screen, screenshots from .claude/outbox and files come back to the phone, scheduled jobs fire against the weekly usage window while the phone sleeps, and a web push wakes it. Optional: other phones that get your APK builds installed (Android app development only), and a peer desktop that takes delegated jobs.
svg.title: waterplane: phone, Tailscale, desktop
svg.desc: Your phone, a waterplane web app or Android app, reaches your desktop over Tailscale, encrypted, with no waterplane server and no account. On the desktop the waterplane daemon types into the real claude CLI running in a PTY, which works in your repos; the screen, screenshots from .claude/outbox and files come back to the phone, scheduled jobs fire against the weekly usage window while the phone sleeps, and a web push wakes it. Optional: other phones that get your APK builds installed (Android app development only), and a peer desktop that takes delegated jobs.

g.text: 1 A prompt goes to the real claude CLI on your desktop
2 The screen streams back as the CLI draws it
3 A screenshot from .claude/outbox arrives as an image
4 Phone asleep: a scheduled job fires as the weekly window resets
5 A push wakes the phone: the job is done
Your phone drives the real claude CLI on your desktop, over Tailscale

fires when the weekly window is back
